## Restoration · Mythic+

Version 34.0.0 · updated 2026-10-23 · [FerrazRestoDruid.yaml](FerrazRestoDruid.yaml)

```md
## 🌿 Restoration Druid Ferraz · Mythic+
-# Version 34.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Wildstalker

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Automatic healing**
- Emergency Regrowth on anyone below your real-HP threshold
- Lifebloom with Everbloom, on yourself or on the tank
- Rejuvenation + Germination spread, keeping 5 or more up for Abundance. Pulls start with Abundance already stacked
- Wild Growth by number of injured allies, Swiftmend on cooldown, Regrowth on Clearcasting and Soul of the Forest
- Nature's Swiftness + instant Regrowth on whoever is low

**Cooldowns**
- Convoke when X allies (tank excluded) drop below your chosen HP. Leaves animal forms first and never casts Convoke in Bear, Cat or Moonkin
- Trinkets and Combat Potion go out before Convoke
- Tranquility automatic or manual

**Defense and utility**
- Predictive Barkskin (reads the next hit), Ironbark on the tank or anyone, Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration
- Healthstone and health potion, even mid-cast, without ever cutting Convoke or Tranquility
- Nature's Cure, Soothe on target and mouseover, Symbiotic on the tank out of combat, Mark of the Wild
- Mouseover emergency healing, mouseover Rebirth and Revitalize, Avatar healing in Temple of Sethraliss
- Breaks roots by shapeshifting, without cutting a cast

**DPS**
- While the group is healthy: Starsurge, Moonfire, Sunfire and Starfire

**Hotkey toggles**
- **Force DPS Only:** turns off proactive healing and goes pure damage
- **Disable Nature's Swiftness:** holds NS for when you want it

> Every slider has a description in the panel. *Effective* = health + heals on the way. *Real HP* = actual health.
```

## Restoration · Raid

Version 26.0.0 · updated 2026-10-23 · [FerrazRestoDruidRaid.yaml](FerrazRestoDruidRaid.yaml)

```md
## 🌳 Restoration Druid Ferraz · Raid
-# Version 26.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Wildstalker with Reforestation

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Automatic healing**
- Emergency Regrowth by real HP, above every other heal
- Reforestation's Tree of Life is detected: Wild Growth and instant Regrowth while you are a tree
- Lifebloom with Everbloom, Rejuvenation + Germination keeping Abundance up, Wild Growth by number of injured
- Swiftmend on cooldown, tree form included, since it still counts toward Reforestation
- Nature's Swiftness + instant Regrowth

**Reforestation**
- Out of combat it builds 3 stacks with Swiftmend, so the first Swiftmend of the pull turns you into a tree
- Works on trash. On bosses the game resets the counter when the encounter starts, so cast the 4th Swiftmend yourself 1-2s before the pull. The tree carries into combat

**Cooldowns**
- Convoke by number of injured, never in an animal form. Trinkets and Combat Potion go out before it
- Tranquility automatic or manual
- Thorn Bloom (racial) and Innervate on yourself

**Defense and utility**
- Predictive Barkskin, Ironbark, Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration
- Healthstone and health potion, without ever cutting Convoke or Tranquility
- Nature's Cure, Soothe, Mark of the Wild, mouseover emergency healing, mouseover Rebirth and Revitalize

**DPS**
- Starsurge, Moonfire and Starfire while fewer than X allies are injured

**Hotkey toggle:** *Disable Nature's Swiftness*

> Symbiotic Relationship stays manual in raid.
```

## Guardian · Mythic+

```md
## 🐻 Guardian Druid Ferraz · Mythic+
-# Version 4.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Elune's Chosen

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Survival first**
- Ironfur for uptime, for predicted damage and to avoid capping rage. Uses Gory Fur procs
- Predictive Barkskin and Survival Instincts that read the next hit with your active defensives already counted, plus HP-based versions
- Barkskin saved for the tank buster predicted on the encounter timeline
- Frenzied Regeneration that counts heals already on the way
- Healthstone and health potion

**Damage**
- Lunar Calling: Thrash becomes Moonfire. Moonfire from Galactic Guardian and Lunation
- Thrash to max stacks, Mangle without capping rage, Maul when rage nears the cap and no heavy hit is coming
- Lunar Beam only while standing, Wild Guardian, Incarnation with trinkets and Combat Potion

**Heart of the Wild**
- Automatic Cat → Feral Frenzy → Bear weave, only when it is safe: a few seconds into the pull, standing still, high health, no tank buster close and a target that will live
- Incarnation waits for HotW only a few seconds at the pull

**Utility**
- Auto Growl on mobs that left you (never in raid)
- Skull Bash on target, mouseover and focus, plus AoE stuns
- Mouseover Moonfire. Pulling with mouseover Moonfire exists but ships off
- Remove Corruption, Soothe, mouseover Rebirth, breaks roots by shapeshifting
```

## Balance · Mythic+

Version 13.0.0 · updated 2026-10-23 · [FerrazBalance.yaml](FerrazBalance.yaml)

```md
## 🌙 Balance Druid Ferraz · Mythic+
-# Version 13.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Elune's Chosen

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Smart burst**
- Waits for the pull to settle: you standing still a few seconds and Moonfire spread across the pack
- Fury of Elune first, Incarnation right after, even if you start moving
- Won't burn Incarnation, Fury of Elune or Starfall on a pack about to die (fight-time sliders)
- Trinkets and Combat Potion with Incarnation
- With *Auto Burst* off you press Incarnation yourself, and trinkets and potion follow it

**Rotation**
- Eclipse handled, Starsurge and Starfall by Astral Power and on Touch the Cosmos procs
- Moonfire and Sunfire spread on mouseover in AoE, bosses skipped
- Its own movement list, instants only
- Optional: Wrath as single-target filler, and swapping off a target about to die

**Defense and support**
- Predictive and HP-based Barkskin, Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration
- Mid-cast emergency: Barkskin, Healthstone and potion. Cuts the cast only to go into Bear
- Keeps working without a valid target, like a boss untargetable phase
- Heart of the Wild in Moonkin heals the party when someone drops
- Thorn Bloom (racial), Solar Beam on target, mouseover and focus
- Remove Corruption, Soothe, mouseover Rebirth and Revive, breaks roots by shapeshifting
```

## Balance · Raid

```md
## 🌌 Balance Druid Ferraz · Raid
-# Version 9.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Elune's Chosen

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Burst**
- Ramp before every Incarnation: DoTs, Lunar Eclipse, Fury of Elune, Incarnation
- Uses Incarnation charges (Whirling Stars) without letting one sit
- Trinkets with Incarnation or when it is still far away. Combat Potion with Incarnation or in the last 30s

**Single target**
- Starfire filler (Lunar Calling), Starsurge in Eclipse and to avoid capping Astral Power
- Touch the Cosmos procs go to Starsurge

**AoE**
- Starfall by Astral Power and on procs
- Fury of Elune timed with Atmospheric Exposure (Sundered Firmament)
- Mouseover Moonfire and Sunfire in add phases

**Defense**
- Predictive and HP-based Barkskin
- Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration and Heart of the Wild (max health)
- Mid-cast emergency. Cuts the cast only to go into Bear
- Keeps working while the boss is untargetable

**Utility**
- Solar Beam on target, mouseover and focus
- Remove Corruption, Soothe, Thorn Bloom (racial), Mark of the Wild
- Mouseover Rebirth and Revive, breaks roots by shapeshifting
```

## Feral · Mythic+

Version 9.0.0 · updated 2026-10-23 · [FerrazFeral.yaml](FerrazFeral.yaml)

```md
## 🐾 Feral Druid Ferraz · Mythic+
-# Version 9.0.0 · Patch 12.1 · Druid of the Claw · Convoke + Berserk

**Build:** copy the string from *Talents → Recommended Talent String* in the rotation panel.

**Burst window**
- Berserk and Convoke lined up, always inside Tiger's Fury
- Cooldowns only once you have stood still a few seconds and the pull will live long enough (fight-time sliders)
- Trinkets in the window. Combat Potion picks a window worth it: minimum targets, boss or long pull

**Rotation**
- Rake and Rip snapshotted with Tiger's Fury
- Ferocious Bite and Ravage, Primal Wrath in AoE, Swipe
- Apex Predator's Craving spent right away, Frantic Frenzy
- Opens from Prowl with Rake

**Survival**
- Predictive and HP-based Barkskin and Survival Instincts
- Panic Bear: goes Bear for Heart of the Wild (max health) and Frenzied Regeneration, then back to Cat
- Predatory Swiftness becomes an instant Regrowth on you, with separate solo and group thresholds
- Healthstone, health potion and out-of-combat Regrowth

**Utility**
- Skull Bash on target, mouseover and focus, Incapacitating Roar
- Remove Corruption, Soothe, mouseover Rebirth and Revive
- Breaks roots by shapeshifting, without cutting Convoke
```

```md
## 🐆 Feral Druid Ferraz · Raid

- Primal Wrath in AoE, Bloodseeker Vines, Panther's Guile on 2 targets, Swipe

**Survival**
- Predictive and HP-based Barkskin and Survival Instincts
- Panic Bear with Frenzied Regeneration
- Predatory Swiftness becomes an instant Regrowth on you
- Healthstone, health potion and out-of-combat Regrowth

**Utility**
- Skull Bash on target, mouseover and focus
- Remove Corruption, Soothe, mouseover Rebirth and Revive
```
